official rules do not connect: the CNY 9.90 is a pay-as-you-go priced item (定价概览: 9.90 元/音色, 按量计费) charged at the FIRST SYNTHESIS with the voice; the plan explicitly excludes 快速复刻 and Credits cover the same resource set as the plan (定价概览 / pricing-token-plan); and account balance is only deducted when a pay-as-you-go API Key is called (付费服务协议 4.3(1)). So the fee can only be collected by a pay-as-you-go synthesis, which this issue forbids. Needs account-specific confirmation from MiniMax.

no official source confirms a voice_id created under a pay-as-you-go key can synthesise under the Subscription Key. get_voice listing is account-scoped and proves visibility, not usability; error 2042 (无权访问该 voice_id) is the documented symptom if visibility does not imply usability. Must not be claimed as supported before one real synthesis answers it.

official_basis.fact: 9.90 元/音色, 按量计费. 复刻音色时不立即收费, 首次使用该音色进行合成时才计入. 试听字符按所选试听模型的单价计费.
可用模型覆盖 MiniMax 全系模型(M3 / M2.7 / 图像 / 语音), 少量特殊模型(MiniMax H3、音色设计、快速复刻等)暂不支持.
积分与 Token Plan 覆盖相同资源; 若同一用量可由套餐内额度和积分覆盖, 优先使用套餐内额度.
通过充值获得的 API Key 与 Token Plan API Key 相互独立, 且不可互换. 使用开放平台 API Key 调用, 按实际用量消耗账户余额.
